name: Virginia

sources.label: Virginia Administrative Code — 8VAC20-132-51 (Graduation requirements, 9th graders 2018–2019 and after)

plans.name: Standard Diploma

subjects.label: English (reading and writing)
subjects.notes: 2 must be verified credits (passed the end-of-course test or an approved substitute).

subjects.label: Mathematics
subjects.notes: At least two different courses from Algebra I, Geometry, Algebra Functions and Data Analysis, Algebra II, or other approved math. 1 verified credit.

subjects.label: Laboratory Science
subjects.notes: Courses from at least two science fields (earth science, biology, chemistry, physics). 1 verified credit.

subjects.label: History and Social Science
subjects.notes: Virginia and U.S. History, Virginia and U.S. Government, and world history or geography. 1 verified credit.

subjects.label: World Language, Fine Arts, or Career and Technical Education
subjects.notes: At least 1 of these must be fine or performing arts or CTE.

plans.notes: Also needs 4 elective credits, including two sequential electives. In total you need 5 verified credits, and only one of them can be a locally awarded verified credit.

plans.name: Advanced Studies Diploma

subjects.label: Mathematics
subjects.notes: At least three different courses from Algebra I, Geometry, Algebra II, or higher math. 1 verified credit.

subjects.label: Laboratory Science
subjects.notes: Courses from at least three science fields (earth science, biology, chemistry, physics). 1 verified credit.

subjects.label: History and Social Science
subjects.notes: Virginia and U.S. History, Virginia and U.S. Government, and two world history or geography courses. 1 verified credit.

subjects.label: World Language
subjects.notes: Three years of one language or two years each of two languages.

subjects.label: Fine Arts or Career and Technical Education

plans.notes: Also needs 3 elective credits, including two sequential electives. In total you need 5 verified credits, and only one of them can be a locally awarded verified credit.

otherRequirements: Earn 5 verified credits by passing end-of-course tests or approved substitute tests
Take an AP, honors, IB, or dual enrollment course, complete a high-quality work-based learning experience, or earn a state-approved CTE credential
Complete one virtual (online) course, which can be non-credit
Get trained in emergency first aid, CPR, and AED use (waivers exist for some students)
Show the "five Cs": critical thinking, creative thinking, collaboration, communication, and citizenship
districtNote: In Virginia, a local school board can add graduation requirements beyond these state minimums, but only if the State Board of Education approves them. Check your school division's requirements.
